description:
Centralization and Vulnerability,Privacy Concerns for Certificate Holders , Limited Integration with Emerging Technologies and Fragmented Credentialing.It solves the above mentioned problems.DECERT Makes Tasks Easier and Safer by providing following things .Effortless Certificate Management,Privacy-Centric Sharing,Secure Blockchain Storage, Automated Verification using ANON AADHAAR SDK for proving Individual's citizenship that eliminates fake certifications and Streamlined Cross-Industry Recognition:- The unified platform eliminates inconsistencies in the credentialing process, making it easier for certificates to be recognized and valued across various industries.

how_its_made: We devised a process to pre-verify users before their registration on our platform. This was achieved by validating the source of each certificate, which served as an anonymous identifier. This approach allowed us to ensure the legitimacy of each user right at the onset of their interaction with our platform.
